prompt: Play back a 1080p mp4-file containing H264 video and MP3 audio, demuxing and rendering video to a display while playing audio to a speaker simultaneously. Uses qtdemux to split streams, h264parse and v4l2h264dec hardware decode with waylandsink for video, and mpegaudioparse with mpg123audiodec and pulsesink for synchronized audio playback.

12-stream multi-batch object detection gst-launch from mp4-file: 12 streams of YOLOv8 grouped into three 4-stream batches via qtibatch with one shared qtimltflite HTP/NPU graph per batch group and qtimldemux per-stream demux, composited into a 4x3 grid via qtivcomposer on a single display. v4l2h264dec hardware decode fanned 12x from one mp4 file; requires batch-4 compiled model (yolov8_det_quantized_batch_4.tflite). Three htp_device_id-spread inference groups avoid HTP memory exhaustion that occurs with 12 independent qtimltflite instances.

16-stream 4x4 video wall from mp4-files: decode 16 independent H.264/AVC mp4-file sources simultaneously and composite into a 4-column by 4-row 1920x1080 grid on a single display output with no camera input and no encode-to-file output. Each of the 16 filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec hardware-decode branches scales to 480x270 and feeds a dedicated qtivcomposer sink pad; the 16-pad composed canvas renders fullscreen on waylandsink. Use for the highest-density concurrent file-decode grid display, 16-up surveillance replay wall, or maximum-stream video tiling (double the stream count of the 8-stream 4x2 grid).

32-stream multistream image classification from mp4-file (H.265) using QNN qtimlqnn engine on the HTP/DSP backend: 32 stream large-scale Inception V3 classification, per-stream Topology A overlay via qtimetamux/qtivoverlay, composited into an 8x4 grid via qtivcomposer on a single display. Each stream runs v4l2h265dec hardware decode, qtimlvconverter, qtimlqnn inference on a QNN .bin model, qtimlpostprocess module=mobilenet. Requires ulimit -n 10000 for fd headroom at this scale.

5-stream H.265 RTSP IP-camera input with YOLOv8 object detection, bounding box overlay, 3x2 grid composite, and RTSP re-stream output. Each of the 5 rtspsrc streams is decoded via v4l2h265dec, tee-split into a raw NV12 passthrough branch and an AI branch (qtimlvconverter → qtimltflite HTP/NPU → qtimlpostprocess unpinned video/x-raw overlay), both feeding paired qtivcomposer sink pads at identical position/dimensions for alpha-composite tiling. 10 composer sink pads total (2 per stream), 1920x720 canvas, 640x360 cells. Named inference elements declared up front (s1_pre/s1_infer/s1_post … s5_post). Output: v4l2h264enc H.264 encode → h264parse config-interval=-1 → qtirtspbin port 8900. Multi-stream RTSP detection grid re-stream, IP camera surveillance, CCTV object detection.

8-stream 4x2 video wall from mp4-files: decode 8 independent H.264/AVC mp4-file sources simultaneously and composite into a 4-column by 2-row 1920x1080 grid on a single display output with no camera input and no encode-to-file output. Each of the 8 filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec hardware-decode branches scales to 480x540 and feeds a dedicated qtivcomposer sink pad; the 8-pad composed canvas renders fullscreen on waylandsink. Use for mid-density concurrent file-decode grid display or 8-up surveillance replay wall (half the stream count of the 16-stream 4x4 grid).

AI wall grid combining four independent AI tasks - image classification (mobilenet), face detection (qfd), semantic segmentation (deeplab-argmax), and object detection (yolov8) - each from its own mp4-file source, all on htp/npu via the QNN external delegate, composited into a 2x2 grid on a single display sink. Each stream decodes with v4l2h264dec and runs its own qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess/qtimetamux/qtivoverlay chain (segmentation instead alpha-blends via qtivcomposer), with the four quadrants tiled by a top-level qtivcomposer onto waylandsink fullscreen.

Decode a flac audio track muxed in an mp4-file, run audio classification, and overlay label text on the video shown on display using a yamnet model. Pipeline demuxes with qtdemux, decodes flacparse/flacdec, extracts features via qtimlaconverter with lmfe params, runs qtimltflite inference, qtimlpostprocess module=yamnet with labels, composites text onto video with qtivcomposer, and outputs via waylandsink.

Run object detection then classification in a daisy-chain pipeline on an mp4-file video and display overlays on display using yolov8 and mobilenet models on htp/npu. Two-stage multi-model pipeline chaining qtimlvconverter, qtimltflite with QNNExternalDelegate, qtimlpostprocess module=yolov8 and module=mobilenet with labels, qtimetamux metadata muxing, qtivoverlay bounding-box overlay, and waylandsink.

Face detection from an mp4-file source to a display sink using a face-detection model (module=qfd) on htp/npu via the QNN external delegate. Single-stream pipeline decodes h264 with v4l2h264dec, runs qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess in a tee branch, remuxes with qtimetamux, overlays boxes with qtivoverlay, and displays fullscreen on waylandsink.

Gesture classifier: four-stage gesture recognition daisy-chain from mp4-file (H.265) to display: palm detection (palmd, stage 1), hand landmark estimation (hlandmark, stage 2), gesture embedding (tensor passthrough, stage 3a), and canned gesture classification (mobilenet postprocess, stage 3b). All four qtimltflite inference stages on HTP/NPU via QNN external delegate. Uses qtimetatransform module=roi-palmd for ROI propagation; result overlaid via qtimetamux/qtivoverlay to waylandsink. H.265 decode (v4l2h265dec); models: palm_detector, hand_landmark_detector, gesture_embedder, canned_gesture_classifier.

Run hand gesture recognition from an isp-camera (qticamsrc) live source and display results on display using palm detection, hand landmark, and gesture classification models on gpu delegate. Multi-stage daisy-chain pipeline with qticamsrc, tee splits, qtimlvconverter, qtimltflite (palmd, hlandmark, tensor, mobilenet modules), qtimlpostprocess, qtimetamux, qtimetatransform module=roi-palmd, qtivoverlay, and waylandsink.

Image classification from an mp4-file source to a display sink using a mobilenet model on htp/npu via the QNN external delegate, with a confidence threshold of 51.0. Single-stream pipeline decodes h264 with v4l2h264dec, runs qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess (module=mobilenet) in a tee branch, remuxes with qtimetamux, overlays classification labels with qtivoverlay, and displays fullscreen on waylandsink.

Play back an MP3 audio file from local storage to a speaker using software decoding. Uses filesrc, mpegaudioparse, mpg123audiodec for software MP3 decode, and pulsesink for audio playback and sound output.

4-stream multistream YOLOv8 object detection compose from mp4-file with per-stream Topology A overlay (qtimetamux + qtivoverlay) and 2x2 grid composition via qtivcomposer to a single display. Each of the 4 streams runs filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec hardware decode, per-stream tee, qtimlvconverter, qtimltflite HTP/NPU external-delegate inference, qtimlpostprocess module=yolov8, and named qtimetamux/qtivoverlay chain.

Save annotated object-detection video to mp4-file on disk with no display (filesink, headless). Reads an mp4-file source, hardware-decodes h264 with filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec, tees into yolov8 QNN HTP inference branch (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess, bbox-stabilization=true), remuxes detection metadata with qtimetamux, overlays bounding boxes with qtivoverlay, then hardware-encodes the annotated stream with v4l2h264enc/h264parse/mp4mux to filesink — no waylandsink, no display, pure record-detection-to-file output.

MQTT/Kafka broker publish via qtimsgpub — forward yolov8 object detection metadata as JSON to an external MQTT or Kafka message broker with no Redis, no display, and no video overlay. Mp4-file source: filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec decode, yolov8 QNN HTP inference (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess module=yolov8, confidence=51.0), detection text/x-raw piped directly into qtimsgpub (topic, host, port, protocol=mqtt|kafka, config, json=true). Use when the downstream consumer is a Mosquitto or Kafka broker rather than Redis.

Redis Pub/Sub publish WITH simultaneous local display via qtiredissink — dual-output: yolov8 detection overlay rendered to waylandsink AND JSON metadata published to a Redis channel in the same pipeline. Mp4-file source: filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec decode, yolov8 QNN HTP inference, qtimetamux/qtivoverlay, then a second tee after qtivoverlay splits into waylandsink (display branch) and qtimlmetaparser module=json / qtiredissink (channel=ml_results, host, port) Redis branch. Use when you need both on-screen overlay and Redis metadata distribution at the same time. Not metadata-only (unlike object_detection_redis_only.sh) and not MQTT/Kafka (unlike object_detection_mqtt_publish.sh).

Redis Pub/Sub metadata-only (no display, no overlay) via qtiredissink — forward yolov8 object detection results as raw text to a Redis channel with no waylandsink and no video overlay. Mp4-file source: filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec/NV12 decode, yolov8 QNN HTP inference (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess module=yolov8, results=5), detection text/x-raw piped directly into qtiredissink (host=127.0.0.1, port=6379, channel=detections). No display branch, no qtimlmetaparser JSON conversion, no qtimsgpub MQTT. Use when only Redis metadata delivery matters and no rendered video is needed.

Bytetrack object tracking from a live ISP camera (qticamsrc) with per-object persistent tracking IDs — publish tracked detection metadata to Redis via qtiredissink, no display and no video overlay. Live qticamsrc source (not mp4-file), yolov8 QNN HTP inference (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess module=yolov8), qtimetamux merges raw video + detection text/x-raw, then qtiobjtracker algo=bytetrack assigns cross-frame tracking IDs, qtimlmetaparser module=json serializes to JSON, qtiredissink (host=127.0.0.1, port=6379, channel=ml_results) publishes to Redis. Use this when you need object tracking (bytetrack persistent IDs across frames) in addition to detection metadata in Redis — distinguishable from object_detection_redis_only.sh (no tracker, no camera source) and from object_tracking_pose_daisychain.sh (no Redis, adds pose daisy-chain to display).

Track detected persons across frames with persistent tracking IDs (bytetrack algorithm) and daisy-chain the tracked detections into a second pose-estimation stage for display. Runs a live isp-camera (qticamsrc) foot-detection (qpd) pipeline on htp/npu via the QNN external delegate, merges detection metadata with qtimetamux, assigns tracking IDs with qtiobjtracker algo=bytetrack, feeds the tracked ROI metadata into a second qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess hrnet pose stage (roi-batch-cumulative mode), remuxes with a second qtimetamux, overlays bounding boxes/tracking IDs/poses with qtivoverlay, and renders fullscreen on waylandsink.

Stream a 1080p H.264/AVC live isp-camera (qticamsrc) feed over rtsp to remote viewers with no ML inference and no local display. Single-stream pipeline launches a gst-rtsp-server and pipes qticamsrc through v4l2h264enc hardware encoder, h264parse, rtph264pay, and udpsink to feed the RTSP server.

Record a 1080p H.264/AVC video stream from an isp-camera (qticamsrc) live source to an mp4-file on disk with no ML inference and no display. Single-stream capture-and-record pipeline using qticamsrc, v4l2h264enc hardware encoder, h264parse, mp4mux, and filesink writing mux.mp4.
Capture audio from a microphone input to a PCM WAV file on disk. Uses pulsesrc for audio capture, audioconvert, and wavenc to encode raw PCM samples into a WAV file via filesink, for sound recording.
Play back a PCM WAV audio file from an mp4-file-like local source to a speaker output. Uses filesrc, wavparse to decode the WAV container, audioconvert, and pulsesink for audio playback/sound output.

Two-stage pose estimation from an mp4-file source to a display sink: a foot_track_net person-detection model (module=qpd) locates people, then an hrnet keypoint model runs on ROI-batched crops (qtimlvconverter mode=roi-batch-cumulative) to estimate pose, both on htp/npu via the QNN external delegate. Cascaded qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess stages are chained through qtimetamux metadata muxers, decoded with v4l2h264dec, overlaid with qtivoverlay, and displayed fullscreen on waylandsink.

Record 1080p H264 video from an isp-camera (qticamsrc) source together with microphone audio into a single MP4 file, combining AV capture of video and MP3-encoded audio. Uses qticamsrc for camera capture, v4l2h264enc hardware encode, pulsesrc for audio capture, lamemp3enc for MP3 audio encoding, mpegaudioparse, and mp4mux to multiplex video and audio into one filesink output.

Applies a geometry transform to a live 1080p camera stream and displays it full-screen on a waylandsink display, rotating the video 180 degrees via qtivtransform. Minimal single-branch pipeline demonstrating on-device rotate/flip/scale video orientation transform from a qticamsrc source directly to a display sink, with no encoding or file output.

Preview an RTSP network stream on a local display — the only camera-preview entry in this cluster where the source is an H.264-encoded network stream (rtspsrc) rather than a raw camera. Decodes the incoming RTP H.264 stream with rtph264depay/h264parse/v4l2h264dec to NV12, then pipes directly to waylandsink fullscreen. No ML inference, no camera sensor, no YUV format conversion. Use when the video source is an RTSP IP camera or network feed.

Semantic segmentation from an mp4-file source to a display sink using a deeplab model (module=deeplab-argmax) on htp/npu via the QNN external delegate. Single-stream pipeline decodes h264 with v4l2h264dec, tees the raw frame into qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess to produce an unpinned video/x-raw segmentation mask, alpha-blends it (alpha=0.5) over the original video with qtivcomposer, and displays fullscreen on waylandsink.

Preview a raw YUV/NV12 stream from an ISP camera (qticamsrc) on a local display — the only camera-preview entry in this cluster using a built-in ISP sensor (qticamsrc, not v4l2src or rtspsrc). qticamsrc at 1920x1080 30fps outputs NV12 directly to waylandsink fullscreen. No format conversion (no qtivtransform), no H.264 decode step, no AI. Use when the camera is the built-in ISP sensor and you need a bare raw NV12 preview.

Single-stream object detection from an isp-camera (qticamsrc) live source to a display sink (waylandsink), no file output and no side-by-side composer. qticamsrc at 1920x1080 NV12 30fps, tee into yolov8 QNN HTP inference branch (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess, bbox-stabilization=true), remuxes detection metadata with qtimetamux, overlays bounding boxes with qtivoverlay, renders fullscreen on waylandsink. Use this for a minimal live ISP camera detection feed to screen.

Single-stream object detection from an mp4-file source to a display sink (waylandsink), no file output and no camera. filesrc/qtdemux/h264parse/v4l2h264dec decodes h264, tees into yolov8 QNN HTP inference branch (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess, bbox-stabilization=true), remuxes detection metadata with qtimetamux, overlays bounding boxes with qtivoverlay, and renders fullscreen on waylandsink. Use this for file-based object detection playback with on-screen overlay.

Single-stream object detection from an RTSP IP-camera stream source to a display sink (waylandsink), no file output. rtspsrc ingests the network stream via rtph264depay/h264parse/v4l2h264dec, tees into yolov8 QNN HTP inference branch (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess, bbox-stabilization=true), remuxes detection metadata with qtimetamux, overlays bounding boxes with qtivoverlay, and renders fullscreen on waylandsink. Use this for network/IP-camera RTSP object detection on-screen.

Single-stream object detection from a USB camera (v4l2src /dev/video0) live source to a display sink (waylandsink), no file output. Captures YUY2 frames from v4l2src, converts colour format to NV12 via qtivtransform, tees into yolov8 QNN HTP inference branch (qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess, bbox-stabilization=true), remuxes detection metadata with qtimetamux, overlays bounding boxes with qtivoverlay, renders fullscreen on waylandsink. Use this for webcam or UVC USB camera object detection on-screen.

Plays back an existing mp4-file from local storage, demuxing and decoding the H.264 video, and renders it full-motion on a waylandsink display. Simple file-playback pipeline using filesrc, qtdemux, h264parse, and the v4l2h264dec hardware decoder to output raw NV12 frames to the display sink.

Run super resolution upscaling on an mp4-file video and display the original and upscaled side-by-side on display using an srnet model on htp/npu. Single-stream pipeline with filesrc, qtdemux, h264parse, v4l2h264dec, tee, qtimlvconverter, qtimltflite with QNNExternalDelegate, qtimlpostprocess module=srnet, qtivcomposer picture-in-picture composition, and waylandsink.

Single-camera 1080p AVC+HEVC dual-codec record plus live display: one qticamsrc (camera=0) fans into three branches simultaneously — H.264/AVC mp4-file record (v4l2h264enc), H.265/HEVC mp4-file record (v4l2h265enc), and raw NV12 waylandsink display preview — with no composition layout and no secondary camera. Use when you need both AVC and HEVC encoded outputs from the same live ISP camera source at the same time alongside an on-screen preview.

Single-camera 3-pane horizontal-strip YUV preview to display with no encoding and no file output: one qticamsrc (camera=0) outputs preview and video pads that are each downscaled to 480x270 via videoscale and fed into three qtivcomposer sink pads arranged side-by-side in a row, rendered fullscreen on waylandsink. No H.264/AVC encode, no mp4 record, no secondary camera, no ML inference — pure live YUV/NV12 camera feed tiled three ways on screen. Use for a 3-pane raw camera preview or multi-output side-by-side display without encoding.

Captures a live camera stream and produces three simultaneous outputs: a 1080p H.264 video recorded to mp4-file, periodic 4K JPEG still-image snapshots written via multifilesink, and a 1080p raw NV12 preview shown live on a waylandsink display. Multi-stream qticamsrc pipeline combining video record, image/jpeg snapshot capture, and live display in one session using v4l2h264enc, h264parse, mp4mux, and multifilesink.

Three-stream object detection from an isp-camera (qticamsrc) live source with dual output: display (waylandsink) AND mp4-file record (filesink). qtivcomposer shows the raw camera feed (sink_0) side-by-side with the yolov8-overlaid detection feed (sink_1) on waylandsink, while a tee on the overlaid branch also hardware-encodes with v4l2h264enc/h264parse/mp4mux to filesink for simultaneous record. Yolov8 QNN HTP inference with qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess and qtimetamux/qtivoverlay. Use this when you need both on-screen preview and saved annotated video.

Play two 1080p MP4 video files simultaneously from an mp4-file source to a display, running two independent decode-and-render pipelines side by side as separate processes. Uses qtdemux, h264parse, and v4l2h264dec hardware decode with capture-io-mode/output-io-mode set to NV12, then waylandsink for dual multi-stream video playback on the display.

Two-stream object detection from a live ISP camera (qticamsrc) to display — side-by-side raw NV12 feed vs YOLOv8-overlaid detection feed on waylandsink. No file output, no mp4 record. qtivcomposer places raw camera (sink_0, left) alongside detected overlay (sink_1, right) fullscreen. YOLOv8 QNN HTP/NPU inference via qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite/qtimlpostprocess; qtimetamux/qtivoverlay for bounding box overlay. Use for live ISP camera object detection with side-by-side preview on display.

Two-stream YOLOX object detection from isp-camera (qtiqmmfsrc) with side-by-side composition and encode-to-file output. ISP camera source tee-split: raw NV12 passthrough to qtivcomposer sink_0 (left 960x1080); AI branch runs qtimlvconverter/qtimltflite HTP external delegate/qtimlpostprocess(yolov8)/qtimetamux/qtivoverlay to qtivcomposer sink_1 (right 960x1080). qtivtransform on overlay branch. Composed output encodes to mp4-file via v4l2h264enc (output-io-mode=5 for camera) + h264parse + mp4mux + filesink. Side-by-side camera detection with simultaneous file record.

Captures a live camera stream and encodes it into two independent H.264 video files at different resolutions, 4K (3840x2160) and 480p (640x480), writing each to a separate mp4-file via filesink. Dual-resolution multi-stream pipeline from a single qticamsrc camera source, using the v4l2h264enc hardware encoder, h264parse, and mp4mux on both branches, with no display sink -- pure record-to-file transcode.

Dual-camera 720p picture-in-picture (PiP) composition with H.264 mp4-file record and RTP/UDP stream output — no local display sink. Two independent qticamsrc sources (camera=0 full-frame 1280x720 background, camera=1 640x360 inset at position 590,310) are composited by qtivcomposer into a PiP overlay layout, then the composed output tees into v4l2h264enc/h264parse/mp4mux filesink for recording and v4l2h264enc/h264parse/rtph264pay/udpsink for live RTP streaming. Use when you need a small camera-1 inset overlaid on a camera-0 background and want both a saved file and a network stream — no on-screen waylandsink preview.

Dual-camera 720p side-by-side stitch to a 2560x720 canvas with H.264 mp4-file record and RTP/UDP stream output — no local display sink. Two independent qticamsrc sources (camera=0 at position 0,0 and camera=1 at position 1280,0, each 1280x720) are placed side-by-side by qtivcomposer into a wide 2560x720 panoramic stitched frame, then the stitched output tees into v4l2h264enc/h264parse/mp4mux filesink for recording and v4l2h264enc/h264parse/rtph264pay/udpsink for live RTP streaming. Use when you need two cameras stitched into a wide panoramic view for both file and network output — no PiP overlay, no on-screen waylandsink preview.

Dual-camera multi-resolution record with on-screen preview and raw YUV file dump — no composition, no RTP. Main camera (qticamsrc camera=0) records 4K (3840x2160) H.264/AVC to main_4k.mp4 and simultaneously shows a 1080p NV12 live preview on waylandsink display; secondary camera (qticamsrc camera=1) records 720p H.264/AVC to secondary_720p.mp4 and also writes raw 720p NV12 frames to secondary_720p.yuv via filesink. Four independent output branches, two cameras, no qtivcomposer layout composition, no RTP stream, no ML inference. Use when you need 4K AVC record from one camera and 720p AVC record from a second camera with simultaneous display and raw YUV capture.

Preview a live USB camera (v4l2src /dev/video0) stream on a local display — the only camera-preview entry in this cluster using a UVC USB webcam (v4l2src, not qticamsrc or rtspsrc). Captures YUY2 from v4l2src, converts to NV12 via qtivtransform, and pipes directly to waylandsink fullscreen. No H.264 decode, no AI, no qtibatch. Use when the capture device is a USB UVC webcam.

VP9 hardware decode and local playback from a .webm file: filesrc → matroskademux → v4l2vp9dec (capture-io-mode=4 output-io-mode=4) → NV12 caps → waylandsink fullscreen display. The only corpus entry using v4l2vp9dec and matroskademux container.
